'''Ceyan Range''' was an area of rocky precipices that was located on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> It was home to a [[Ceyan Range Raceway|podracing raceway]],<ref name="RR" /> as well as an extensive [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] population.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] counterpart [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] destroyed an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] on the north side of the range.<ref name="ItWoSWT" />
